units.source_text: 源氏看了这诗，觉得明石夫人的笔致依旧清新可喜。

en.t: Genji read the poem and felt that Lady Akashi's brushwork was still fresh and pleasing.

units.source_text: 想道：“紫夫人起初嫌恶此人，后来互相谅解，深信此人稳重可靠。

en.t: He thought, "At first Lady Murasaki disliked her, but later they came to understand each other, and she firmly believed that this woman was steady and dependable.

units.source_text: 然而和她交往，并非全无顾虑，却取优雅和爱的态度，外人都看不出紫夫人用心之周至。”

en.t: Yet in dealing with her she was not entirely without reservations; still, she adopted an attitude of grace and affection, so that outsiders could not see how thoroughly considerate Lady Murasaki had been."

units.source_text: 源氏每逢寂寞无聊之时，常常到明石夫人那里作普通一般的访问。

en.t: Whenever Genji felt lonely and bored, he often went to Lady Akashi's place for an ordinary, casual visit.

units.source_text: 但绝不像从前那样亲昵了。

en.t: But he was certainly no longer intimate with her as he had been before.
